definition.simple: A score for how well you followed your plan on a trade. It never uses profit or loss.
definition.balanced: It rewards a stop set before entry, risk within your limit, an entry that matched your rules, and a completed review. A winning trade that broke rules does not score well. A losing trade that followed the plan can score well.

example: A trade where you moved your stop and still won scores lower than a planned trade that hit its stop.
